title: Publish Attention events to X
owner_request: Each Attention event becomes an X post. Use Key Vault credentials, full JavaScript Chrome and cookies, with hard pacing. Keep it simple.

implementation.text: Use the existing reviewed event_title verbatim. No separate writer, reviewer, research call, rewriting or clipping.
implementation.identity: Use the event ID already supplied by Attention. Save the X receipt; the same event ID is not sent twice. A new feed event ID is a new publication entry.
implementation.connection: Scrapling Chrome with JavaScript, cookies and localStorage. Bootstrap from saved state; use Key Vault username/password if sign-in expires. Check the actual account. Stop on verification challenges.
implementation.credentials: spectral-nature-kvault: twitter-username and twitter-password. Browser-state key stays in Key Vault; the refreshed browser state is encrypted in PostgreSQL.
implementation.guard: One renewable account lease across workers/environments. Hard network and posting limits survive a process restart. Uncertain submissions stop further delivery.
implementation.feed: Read completed Attention publications. Persist a starting boundary and acknowledge each retained batch so downtime does not silently skip indexed publications.
implementation.operation: One local watch process prepares existing headlines and publishes pending events. No Azure application deployment or cloud schedule is changed.

verification.headline_publishing: Not accepted: creation response timed out and readback did not confirm the attempted headline.

status: Simplified implementation retained. Automatic posting is not locally accepted: X did not return a receipt for the first feed-headline attempt, and the authenticated profile check did not confirm it. Publisher stopped; no retry.
retired_work: Separate editor pipeline and all shared-agent changes were removed after the owner requested simplification. Eight unsent drafts were archived and removed from delivery. Original provider attempts and unknown billing remain in the verification record.

local_worker.restart: Reconcile the uncertain submission before restarting delivery.
local_worker.last_outcome: One uncertain submission; eight prepared headlines. Only the earlier SHOP post is confirmed live.
